title: Service Contracts: overdue and suspension periods by tier
content:
## Scope
This quick-reference card lists the two default periods of each Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tier: the calendar days after the payment due date after which an unpaid shortfall suspends the contract, and the calendar days of continuous suspension after which the line may terminate the contract.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Overdue period before suspension (calendar days after the payment due date) | Continuous suspension before the line may terminate (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 15 | 30 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 15 | 30 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 30 | 45 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 30 | 60 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 45 | 60 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 60 | 90 |

## Quick questions
**How long after the due date may an unpaid shortfall run before an AHL Global Account Contract is suspended for it?** The tier's overdue period is 45 calendar days after the payment due date.

**For how long must an AHL Strategic Partner Contract stay suspended before the line may terminate it?** 90 calendar days of continuous suspension.
